fact: Alleged failure to slow under yellow flags at Turn 15.
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix H, Article 2.5.5 b) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry and in-car video evidence. There was a single yellow flag was brought out because Car 6 crashed at Turn 15 on Lap 5. After reviewing the data, we determined that Car 14 dealt appropriately with the yellow flag situation at Turn 15. We took no further action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 14 Alleged Yellow Flag Infringement
to: The Team Manager, Aston Martin Aramco F1 Team
